integrity: Universal classifications follow from a positive Gram decomposition and strict positive deficits. Independent finite exact enumeration of the implemented branch map corroborates the formulas but is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the retained-garbage compare-and-swap sampler with L=2^n, B=2^b and strict 0<=t_j<B; does not address full-keep encodings, ancilla uncomputation, later cleaned alias samplers or oracle applications that use PREPARE and PREPARE inverse.
title: Finite-precision rigidity of coherent alias sampling: pure-output and uniform-output classifications
